_meta.source: Extracted directly from in-game screenshots (images/assistant info, images/device info) provided by the user. Currency amounts (prices) are kept here since they're needed for game balance/economy, unlike the general mechanics doc which drops reward amounts.
_meta.assistant_mechanic: Exactly one Auction Assistant is chosen before a match. Its ability fires automatically on the schedule described, every match, at no cost.
_meta.device_mechanic: Players buy one Device Set before a match (costs currency). Buying it grants ALL devices listed inside that set (3-5 individual one-time-use devices) into the player's inventory. Each individual device can be triggered manually once, during any round, via a button on the auction screen. So a Device Set with 4 devices listed gives you 4 separate single-use activations total across the match (not 4 per round) — the user confirmed: 'when you buy a device [set], you get all the 3 or 4 devices included there. You can use all [each] once.' Unused devices persist to future matches per the general mechanics doc.
_meta.verification_status: All device sets and assistants below are user-confirmed complete and accurate against in-game screenshots — no open gaps.

auctionAssistants.name: Adler
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: Those without sight are not always blind to the truth.
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals collectible silhouettes by rarity: White in Round 1, Green in Round 2, Blue in Round 3, and Purple in Round 4.

auctionAssistants.name: Haniel
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: After 99 pulls, surely something good has to happen... right?
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the rarity and silhouettes of 5 random collectibles at auction start, then reveals the rarity of 2 unknown collectibles each round after.

auctionAssistants.name: Jiuyuan
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: The most valuable intel always comes first, of course.
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the silhouette of 1 highest-rarity collectible at auction start. Each following round reveals the rarity and silhouette of 1 random collectible.

auctionAssistants.name: Chiz
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: Go on, take a bite of the golden apple.
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the silhouettes of 8 random collectibles at auction start. In Round 3, reveals the identities of those same 8 collectibles from Round 1.

auctionAssistants.name: Hathor
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the rarity of all collectibles at the start of Round 5.

auctionAssistants.name: Edgar
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: Playing it safe is still a strategy.
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the rarity and silhouettes of all White-, Green-, and Blue-rarity collectibles at auction start.

auctionAssistants.name: Daffodill
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: She sees the whole board at a glance.
auctionAssistants.ability: Reveals the total number of Purple-, Gold-, and Red-rarity collectibles at auction start.

auctionAssistants.name: Hotori
auctionAssistants.flavorQuote: Never underestimate the eye of an antique dealer.
auctionAssistants.ability: In Rounds 1-3, reveals the silhouette of 1 random collectible of unknown type. In Round 5, reveals the silhouettes of all collectibles with known rarity.
